title: GASTRIC STEEL // FORTY HONEYED LOCUSTS
narrative: In Daznak's Pit, Strong Belwas finishes the entire silver bowl of poisoned honeyed locusts, licking each sticky claw with gusto. The tears of Lys burn through horse stomachs; Belwas merely lets out an earthquake belch that knocks over two Brazen Beasts. 'Strong Belwas needs more liver!' he shouts, slapping his scarred belly. 'Poison makes Strong Belwas digest faster!' The Harpy's conspirators drop their daggers in existential despair.
resolvesPlotHole: Strong Belwas Survives Lethal Poison Through Pure Mass
